title: Nurturing Jamaican Hibiscus Stew
description: A floral, gooey, cozy Jamaican stew featuring smoked paprika and a gentle braise, kosher-friendly and comforting.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic, smoked paprika, ground ginger, and turmeric, cooking for 1 minute.
Add sliced carrots, cubed sweet potato, and diced bell pepper, sautéing for 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, coconut milk, and dried hibiscus flowers, bringing to a simmer.
Add cubed tofu and cover, reducing heat to low and letting the stew braise for 20 minutes.
Stir occasionally, ensuring the hibiscus has released its color into the broth.
Remove lid, cook for an additional 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle stew into bowls and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve hot with steamed rice or crusty bread.
